agentsDiscovered.name: Agent Security Harness
agentsDiscovered.description: 342-test security harness for autonomous AI agents. MCP, A2A, x402/L402, AIUC-1 pre-certification testing. Production-validated 97.9%.
agentsDiscovered.notes: Just published 3 days ago (Mar 31). Extensive x402/L402 payment flow testing. Author has peer-reviewed research (5 preprints, 3 NIST submissions). Highly active developer.

agentsDiscovered.name: XMR402
agentsDiscovered.description: XMR402 is an open, stateless, decentralized HTTP payment standard for Monero. AI-to-Service payments with millisecond-level 0-conf transaction proofs.
agentsDiscovered.notes: Protocol-level agent payment infrastructure for Monero. IETF standard compatible. Privacy-first design with HMAC-SHA256 instruction binding.

agentsDiscovered.name: Stronghold
agentsDiscovered.description: CLI-driven security proxy scanning HTTP requests for threats using Citadel AI engine. Pay-per-request via x402 ($0.001/scan).
agentsDiscovered.notes: Network-level AI agent protection with x402 micropayments. Transparent proxy intercepts traffic at kernel level. Bidirectional scanning (prompt injection + credential leaks).

agentsDiscovered.name: PincerPay
agentsDiscovered.description: Open source on-chain USDC payment gateway for AI agents. Non-custodial x402 facilitator with merchant and agent SDKs.
agentsDiscovered.notes: Multi-chain x402 facilitator (Base, Solana, Polygon). Merchant SDK for Express/Hono. Agent SDK with automatic 402 handling. 47 tests across 5 suites.

agentsDiscovered.name: P-Link MCP
agentsDiscovered.description: x402 client implementation (x402-fetch), HTTP 402 server implementation and Model Context Protocol (MCP) for P-Link.io.
agentsDiscovered.notes: x402 + MCP integration for P-Link.io payment platform. Enables agents to pay, send and receive money. Combines two major agent standards.
